name: smart-reply-router
description: Answer incoming email and messenger messages while calling the LLM only for replies that need new text: Jev triages each message in one batch (intent, FAQ match, urgency, spam, needs-human), code routes to ignore / human / FAQ template / LLM draft. Drafts by default; auto-send only for whitelisted FAQ templates on explicit opt-in; red-line topics always go to the human.
